name: Kathleen Wynne
description: The Honourable Kathleen Wynne, 25th Premier of Ontario and Former Leader of the Ontario Liberal Party
excerpt: Lee has what it takes in terms of leadership and capacity to lead us
endorsement: I am very happy to be able to throw my support behind Lee Fairclough. I really believe that Lee has what it takes in terms of leadership and capacity to lead us through these next number of years and such a time of uncertainty. Lee was the Chief Executive and the President of the St. Mary’s General Hospital during the COVID pandemic. She has been a member of the legislature—the fact that Lee has a seat is going to allow her to change the discussion of politics in Ontario. She’s going to be able to take on Doug Ford in the legislature, and she’s in politics because she really believes that there is a way to make change and that government can be a force for good in people’s lives. That’s why she can lead us. That’s why I’m supporting her.

name: Tyler Watt
description: MPP Nepean
excerpt: Lee is kind, genuine, and the change our party needs.
endorsement:
I'm proud to endorse my friend and colleague, Lee Fairclough, to be the next Leader of the Ontario Liberal Party.

Lee is kind, genuine, and the change our party needs. She leads with integrity, brings people together, and has the vision to build a stronger future for Ontario.

name: Ted Hsu
description: MPP Kingston and the Islands | Co-Chair of Lee Fairclough's Campaign
excerpt: She will be a fresh start for the Ontario Liberal Party.
endorsement:
I believe that Lee Fairclough is the leader we need to earn the trust and confidence of voters, to win seats across the province, and to lead Ontario after the next election.

Anybody who meets Lee immediately comes away with the impression that she is thoughtful, serious and honest. My impression has only been solidified by working together with Lee, using our seats in the Legislature to oppose the Ford government at every turn, but always doing politics in a first-class way. In these troubled times, I believe voters want the best politicians to be leading us.

I know Lee will be able to lead a strong and diverse caucus, just as she led St. Mary's General hospital in Kitchener, before being inspired to help fix our healthcare system by entering politics in 2022. She will be a fresh start for the Ontario Liberal Party.

She is connected to different parts of the province, having grown up in rural Bruce County and Scarborough, studied in Hamilton and Waterloo, and lived and worked in the GTA and Kitchener.

Lee beat a Conservative to win her seat in her home riding of Etobicoke Lakeshore, immediately committing to stay in the fight after a close loss in 2022. She is also a competitor, as a swimmer and as a member of Canada's national women's rugby team. No doubt she has the perseverance and fighting spirit to lead us into the next election campaign and beyond.

name: Lucille Collard
description: MPP Ottawa-Vanier
excerpt: Lee is the kind of leader who can not only defeat Ford, but also rebuild a strong, grassroots movement that truly reflects all Ontarians.
endorsement:
I'm proud to support MPP Lee Fairclough as the next leader of the Ontario Liberal Party. Lee is the kind of leader who can not only defeat Ford, but also rebuild a strong, grassroots movement that truly reflects all Ontarians.

I've seen her in action as a caucus colleague, and from the very beginning, she stepped into the arena with confidence, challenging the government's misplaced priorities with clarity and conviction. Her leadership stands in sharp contrast to this Premier's. She leads with integrity, she listens, and she puts people first. I trust her to stand up for what's right, even when it's not easy.

Lee brings real-world experience, a sharp focus on what matters most, and a collaborative, team-oriented approach. She has both the drive and the discipline to deliver meaningful results for Ontario.

At a time when people are looking for leadership they can trust, leadership that understands their daily realities and is ready to act, Lee is that leader.

name: Stephanie Smyth
description: MPP Toronto-St. Paul's
excerpt: She is authentic, she has integrity, and she cares deeply about the issues facing Ontarians.
endorsement: As a journalist for more than three decades, I built my career on integrity and holding people in power to account. I questioned them on their policies, plans, and politics. Now, as a sitting MPP choosing a candidate to support for the leadership of the Ontario Liberal Party, I applied the same approach. I asked myself who would be best for Ontario. To me, Lee Fairclough came out on top. She is authentic, she has integrity, and she cares deeply about the issues facing Ontarians—such as access to health care, education, and affordability. Without hesitation, I am endorsing Lee Fairclough.

name: James Maloney
description: Member of Parliament for Etobicoke-Lakeshore, Caucus Chair
excerpt: Lee Fairclough is exactly what the Ontario Liberal Party needs.
endorsement:
Lee Fairclough is exactly what the Ontario Liberal Party needs.

Lee understands and has the right experience to tackle the issues that matter to our province: healthcare; education; economic development.

Ontario needs true leadership.

Ontario needs a new vision.

We need a leader who cares.

Lee Fairclough is that person.

name: Maya Abrokwah
description: Policy Co-Chair | University of Toronto Young Liberals
excerpt: Lee also has the know-how to get more people involved in our party, ranging from youth to seniors, from the cities to the North, and from all over the province.
endorsement: It is my pleasure to endorse Lee Fairclough for leadership of the Ontario Liberal Party. As Policy Co-Chair for the University of Toronto Young Liberals, I can say that Lee's expertise in policy and experience in the healthcare sector is just what the party and the province needs. Lee also has the know-how to get more people involved in our party, ranging from youth to seniors, from the cities to the North, and from all over the province. There is no doubt in my mind Lee is just what we need.

name: Talal Akbar
description: President, Toronto–Danforth Young Liberals
excerpt: MPP Lee Fairclough has shown a genuine commitment to building a stronger future for Ontario.
endorsement:
MPP Lee Fairclough has shown a genuine commitment to building a stronger future for Ontario. I believe that issues like healthcare, education and affordability are essential to creating opportunities for people and improving the lives of communities across our province.

I’m proud to support Lee because I believe in her ideas and her vision for Ontario. I look forward to seeing her continue working toward a province where people have access to the services and opportunities they need to succeed.

name: Walter Alvarez-Bardales
description: Doctor Honoris Causa in Human Rights | Advocate for Healthcare Access & Disability Issues | Former Ontario Liberal Party Candidate, York–Simcoe 2022, Simcoe North 2025
excerpt: She can inspire our party, earn the trust of Ontarians and, importantly, win.
endorsement:
I am proud to support Lee Fairclough because I believe her priorities are in the right place.

As a healthcare-access researcher, I know that the challenges facing Ontario's healthcare system are not abstract policy problems. They affect real people and families, sometimes with profound consequences. Lee understands that reality from both her frontline healthcare experience and senior leadership. I believe she has the intellect to understand complex problems, the compassion to remember the people behind them, and the leadership to turn evidence into action.

Ontario needs a leader who can strengthen our publicly funded healthcare system while bringing people together around a practical and hopeful vision for the province. I believe Lee is that leader. She can inspire our party, earn the trust of Ontarians and, importantly, win. That is why she has my wholehearted support.

name: Hon. Dr. Jean Augustine P.C., C.M., O.Ont., C.B.E.
description: Former Parliamentary Secretary to Prime Minister Jean Chrétien | Former Minister of State for Multiculturalism and Status of Women
excerpt: She's a team player focused on an Ontario that works for people.
endorsement:
Growing up in Grenada I learned the important qualities of belonging, service, sharing and giving. As an activist, I have been devoted to making improvements in society and sought out others I could work with to push for causes together.

Lee Fairclough represents those same qualities. She too learned early in life that if you believe in something, you can't sit on the sidelines waiting for change you have to get involved. Lee knows that positive change comes from listening, collaboration and action. She's a team player focused on an Ontario that works for people: investing in health care and education; and a leader who can deliver the best results for all of us regardless of who we are or where we live.

Lee Fairclough is my choice for Leader of the Ontario Liberal Party.

name: Karim Bardeesy
description: Member of Parliament, Taiaiako'n—Parkdale—High Park | Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister of Industry
excerpt: I'm thrilled to endorse Lee Fairclough for leadership of the Ontario Liberal Party.
endorsement: I'm thrilled to endorse Lee Fairclough for leadership of the Ontario Liberal Party.

name: Andrea Cohen Barrack
description: Fundraising Chair, Lee Fairclough Leadership Campaign
excerpt: Lee truly understands Ontarians, and she's ready to fight for them.
endorsement: Lee Fairclough is the leader Ontario needs. Her integrity is unwavering, her leadership experience — from hospital executive to MPP for Etobicoke—Lakeshore — is proven, and she brings the fresh thinking required to take on today's toughest challenges. Lee truly understands Ontarians, and she's ready to fight for them.

name: Morris Beckford
description: Former Ontario Liberal Candidate for Scarborough-Rouge Park 2025
excerpt: She gets that on day one as Premier, she will need to get working to build an Ontario where everyone feels like they belong!
endorsement:
I fully and proudly endorse Lee Fairclough for Ontario Liberal Party Leader and the next Premier of Ontario!

I met Lee years ago when we sat together on the York Community Services Board, and though we only worked together briefly, I got the sense that she was a person of integrity. A few weeks ago, a few friends and I sat down with Lee to talk about the kind of future she envisions for Ontario. I gotta tell you, it was refreshing! She gets that we can build something better. She gets that on day one as Premier, she will need to get working to build an Ontario where everyone feels like they belong! An Ontario not just for the wealthy few. She gets that we are all on Team Ontario and that if a portion of Team Ontario feels abandoned, we will all lose!

name: Shelley Blackmore
description: Former Ontario Liberal Candidate for Huron-Bruce Past Chair of Fundraising for the Ontario Liberal Rural and Northern Commission
excerpt: I'm proud to endorse Lee Fairclough as the best person to lead our party into victory over the Ford Conservatives.
endorsement: I'm proud to endorse Lee Fairclough as the best person to lead our party into victory over the Ford Conservatives. Lee grew up in my riding of Huron-Bruce, and she recognizes that people in rural and Northern Ontario need a stronger voice in Provincial government. Lee has demonstrated empathy, integrity and an incredible work ethic in her role as an MPP. With her skills and leadership experience, I'm confident that she'll lead a team that makes life better for all Ontarians.

name: Dr. Marie Bountrogianni
description: Former Chief Psychologist Hamilton-Wentworth District School Board | Former Dean, Metropolitan Toronto University | Former Ontario Minister of Children and Youth Services
excerpt: Lee can be tough—she’s a former rugby player—yet empathetic.
endorsement:
The Conservative Government is failing Ontario. Students no longer have the classroom supports they need: teachers are trying to reach their students in over-crowded classes without the proper tools.

For Liberals to form the next Government in Ontario, we need a leader who connects with voters, who can relate to their concerns and build the team to deliver what Ontarians want and need.

The best candidate for that job is Lee Fairclough. She listens when people speak. She’s a parent with kids in the education system. She’s the daughter of ageing parents who worry about what health care support will be there when they need it. Lee can be tough—she’s a former rugby player—yet empathetic.

I believe Lee Fairclough offers leadership that will carry Ontario Liberals to win the next election. She has my vote.

name: Boyan Boyanov
description: President, Etobicoke Centre Young Liberals | LPC (O) Etobicoke Regional Coordinator
excerpt: Lee has consistently demonstrated that she has the knowledge and experience that I believe are necessary to lead our Party and represent the people of Ontario.
endorsement:
Re-building and strengthening the Ontario Liberal Party will take a committed and experienced leader who can unite people and create a Party that we can all be proud of.

Throughout my work with constituents and Liberal organizations across Etobicoke, I have seen firsthand the importance of having an engaged leader who understands the issues residents face, listens to their concerns, and actively works to bring everyone together.

Lee has consistently demonstrated that she has the knowledge and experience that I believe are necessary to lead our Party and represent the people of Ontario.

That is why I am proud to endorse Lee Fairclough for leader of the OLP.

name: Sheila Bryan
description: President | Ontario Liberal Seniors' Commission
excerpt: Lee leads with HEAD and HEART.
endorsement:
I’m pleased to personally endorse Lee Fairclough for Leader of the Ontario Liberal Party.

Why Lee? She’s the real deal. Authentic. Warm. Approachable. She meets people where they are, gives each person her full attention and genuinely listens to perspectives different from her own.

Here’s what sets Lee apart for me: her approach to collaborative leadership. She doesn’t believe leadership means having all the answers. She understands that good ideas come from many places. She doesn’t confuse listening with leadership. She turns listening into joint action.

Lee brings people together and understands that meaningful policies are built with people, not handed down to them.

She has demonstrated resilience, knows well what it takes to win a tough election, and understands the very challenging economic and social issues facing Ontarians.

Lee leads with HEAD and HEART. And that’s why she has my support.

name: Ian Burbidge
description: President, Huron-Bruce Provincial Liberal Association
excerpt: She has the background and skill to build and lead a team capable of bringing compassion, order and good governance back to this province.
endorsement:
Lee Fairclough has convinced me that she is the leader our party needs right now; the leader I want to work with to rebuild our Liberal team. Her roots in the rural southwest and experience in our urban and suburban heartland, provide her with an intimate understanding of the diversity of Ontario.

Lee speaks to me not as a vote to be earned, or just a voter to be convinced, but as someone with valuable feelings and experiences that she could learn from and build on. She has the background and skill to build and lead a team capable of bringing compassion, order and good governance back to this province. I encourage Ontario Liberals to support Lee for Leader.

name: Luke Calabretta
description: Regional Coordinator - Etobicoke/Downtown/East York (EDEY), Ontario Young Liberals
excerpt: Lee has the ability to bridge the rural urban divide and unify the different groups within our party to build a winning coalition which sets her apart.
endorsement: In my role as the Toronto (EDEY) Regional Coordinator for the Ontario Young Liberals, I've seen Lee consistently show up, listen and invest in the work of building up our party while prioritizing the voices of youth and the issues facing them. Lee has the ability to bridge the rural urban divide and unify the different groups within our party to build a winning coalition which sets her apart. I look forward to working with Lee to deliver the results Ontarians have been asking for.

name: Hon Marie-P. Charette-Poulin B.A., LL.B., M.A.
description: Senator representing Northern Ontario from 1995 to 2015/Sénateure du nord de l'Ontario de 1995 à 2015 | President of the Liberal Party of Canada from 2006 to 2008/Présidente du PLC de 2006 à 2008
excerpt: Our province deserves and needs a Premier who leads and governs with wisdom, with balance, with discernment, with courage, with experience, with respect, with dignity.
endorsement:
Why I'm Backing Lee Fairclough/Pourquoi j'appuie Lee Fairclough

Dear friends/chers amis,

Our province deserves and needs a Premier who leads and governs with wisdom, with balance, with discernment, with courage, with experience, with respect, with dignity.

And that is what Lee Fairclough exudes.

Her current work as an MPP for the riding of Etobicoke-Lakeshore has enabled her to understand what representing a riding really means, what pubic service involves, what active listening can do, what team work can accomplish.

Her past professional governance in healthcare will be key to her success as a Leader, then as a Premier: yes our healthcare system is facing major challenges. She understands what needs to be done.

Also her belief in the importance of education sets her apart from the leaders of the other parties. Our provincial education system is facing major challenges, at every level. She is convinced that Nelson Mandela hit the ball out of the park when he said: “Education is the most powerful weapon which you can use to change the world.”

And we need to change a few things in Ontario to make it a better place to live, be you in Toronto or Ottawa or Sudbury or Windsor…

Oui, de plus, Lee Fairclough reconnait la place importante qu'occupe la langue et la culture françaises en Ontario. Elle comprend les nombreuses contributions des “francos” au mieux-être de l'Ontario. Elle accueille à bras ouverts les nouveaux canadiens francophones en Ontario.

L'avenir de notre province dépend de la qualité de notre éducation, que les résidents aient 6 ans ou 26 ans. Lee sait que notre système doit attiser notre curiosité intellectuelle, notre créativité, notre fierté.

Sa connaissance de nos services de santé sauront lui permettre d'apporter, comme Première ministre de l'Ontario, des changements immédiats, pratiques et simples pour augmenter l'accès et la qualité de ces services.

Lee est une personne intègre et motivée. Elle fait une différence pour les gens de sa circonscription. Je suis fière de l'appuyer comme future cheffe du Parti libéral de l'Ontario, comme future première ministre de la province.

name: Hon. Cav. Caroline Di Cocco
description: President, Sarnia-Lambton Provincial Liberal Association | Former Ontario Minister of Culture
excerpt: Lee is grounded and prepared to take on Doug Ford and his government.
endorsement:
As a former MPP and Cabinet Minister under Dalton McGuinty, I am pleased to endorse Lee Fairclough to lead the Ontario Liberal Party.

Lee knows the issues facing Ontario. With a seat in the Ontario Legislature she sees every day what is working in this province and what is not. Lee’s life experiences, especially her leadership roles before securing a seat at Queen’s Park, have prepared her to be an effective and strong leader.

I am confident Lee will stand strong against threats to Ontario and Canada. Her experience on Canada’s Women’s Rugby Team, combined with her grasp of the issues and commitment to improving health care, education, and the economy, make her the best candidate to lead the Ontario Liberals.

In these unsettled times, we need a strong leader who is already a member of the Ontario Legislature and understands the issues. Lee is grounded and prepared to take on Doug Ford and his government.

name: Penny Collenette C.M., O.Ont
description: Former Federal Candidate (Ottawa Centre) | Former Senior Director, PMO.
excerpt: There is no question in my mind that Lee is a fighter.
endorsement:
There is no question in my mind that Lee is a fighter.

Her spirit, both as a competitive athlete and a politician, who came back to win her seat in 2025 from a tough loss in 2022, speaks volumes about her courage.

That fighting spirit, combined with her health sector experience as a technician and hospital President, will be valuable qualities for Ontario voters.

She is exactly the type of authentic and forthright force the Ontario Liberal Party needs as our Leader. I am delighted to give her my endorsement.

name: Sean Conway
description: Former Liberal MPP (Renfrew North/Renfrew-Nipissing-Pembroke) and Minister from 1975-2003
excerpt: I like the fact that Lee won a riding - Etobicoke Lakeshore - in Doug Ford's backyard in the 2025 Ontario provincial election.
endorsement:
I want to take this opportunity to publicly announce that I will be supporting Lee Fairclough as the next leader of the Ontario Liberal Party.

There are many good reasons why I have decided to support Ms. Fairclough. The first is that she hails from and grew up in Bruce County, Southwestern Ontario. That experience will serve her well as our next provincial party leader. Meeting her recently in my hometown of Barry's Bay in the Upper Ottawa Valley, I was struck by how easily she connected with people she was meeting for the first time. Her easy and friendly manner, her warm smile and her evident interest in the concerns of folks in rural and northern areas will serve her very well as the leader of our party.

I like the fact that Lee won a riding - Etobicoke Lakeshore - in Doug Ford's backyard in the 2025 Ontario provincial election. Having lost that riding in the previous 2022 Ontario election by less than 1,000 votes, she didn't walk away from the challenge but rather strengthened her team and sharpened her message and won with a comfortable majority on her second time out as our candidate. She has demonstrated resilience and grit in the early days of her political life and those two qualities are very important to me as a voter in this leadership campaign.

I also like the fact that Lee has had a very successful career in athletics, especially women's rugby and competitive swimming at the university level. From my experience, playing sports is a great way to learn practically what successful teamwork involves and I have to think that leading a national rugby team would provide valuable leadership training.

Having spoken with several people who know Lee, they all comment on her deep understanding of health care issues. Decades ago, I served as the Liberal Health Critic and I know from personal experience how challenging and complicated that role can be. I truly believe that one of Lee's greatest strengths - and she has many - is her understanding of the issues and the solutions to our current health care challenges gained by 27 years of working in that critical sector. I always like to remind my friends that in Ontario today, health care consumes approximately 43% of our provincial budget which is now over $200 billion annually.

As I write this personal endorsement, we are a little over seven weeks away from D-Day in this leadership campaign. While I am impressed by other candidates in this race, when I consider very important leadership characteristics such as important personality traits like warmth, openness and an easy manner with people, her life before politics especially her many years working in health care at many levels and in many places, and her confidence in presenting the Liberal case with clarity, good sense and an evident balance, Lee Fairclough is my first choice on November 21st.

name: John Creelman
description: Mayor, Town of Mono, Dufferin County
excerpt: In Lee I see someone ready and well prepared to lead Liberals and eventually the Province on day one.
endorsement:
In supporting Lee Fairclough for Leader, I join the company of many Liberals I’ve known and worked with over the years.

If I have learned anything from my last 35 years in public life on municipal councils and as a Justice of the Peace, it is that we need people at Queen’s Park who will actually listen. Lee listens and understands the issues.

The municipal sector craves leadership and policies at Queen’s Park that will treat Ontario’s towns and cities not as ‘creatures of the Province’ but rather with respect and consideration of our problems and funding challenges. Lee totally gets this.

Early in my career I worked with three former Liberal leaders. In Lee I see someone ready and well prepared to lead Liberals and eventually the Province on day one.

name: Dr. Alvin Curling O.Ont.
excerpt: She is exactly the leader we need and I'm proudly endorsing her.
endorsement: I have always been a passionate advocate of the democratic process, inclusiveness and the protection of rights for all people in Ontario. When I met Lee Fairclough I was impressed by her approach to engaging with people at all levels. During this stage of rebuilding the Ontario Liberal Party, Lee's approach is refreshing and both important and impressive. She is exactly the leader we need and I'm proudly endorsing her.

name: Manu Datta
description: President, Mississauga-Malton Provincial Liberal Association
excerpt: I believe she has the vision and determination to unite our party and earn the trust of Ontarians.
endorsement:
Leadership is about listening, bringing people together, and having the courage to move forward.

As a Riding President in Mississauga-Malton, I know the importance of strong, experienced, and community-focused leadership. That is why I am proud to endorse Lee Fairclough for Leader of the Ontario Liberal Party.

Lee brings experience, compassion, and a genuine commitment to building a stronger Ontario. I believe she has the vision and determination to unite our party and earn the trust of Ontarians.

I'm proud to stand with Lee. The next chapter starts now.

name: Samridhi Datta
description: President, Brampton East Provincial Liberal AssociationVice President of Young Women, Ontario Women’s Liberal Commission
excerpt: I'm confident she can bring our party together, strengthen our movement, and build a future that gives more people a reason to believe in Ontario's Liberal vision.
endorsement:
I'm proud to endorse Lee Fairclough for Leader of the Ontario Liberal Party.

As President of the Brampton East Provincial Liberal Association and Vice President of Young Women for the Ontario Liberal Women's Commission, I believe our party needs leadership that listens, connects with communities, and inspires the next generation to get involved.

Lee brings experience, integrity, and a genuine commitment to serving Ontarians. I'm confident she can bring our party together, strengthen our movement, and build a future that gives more people a reason to believe in Ontario's Liberal vision.

I'm proud to stand with Lee and support her campaign for the next chapter of our party.

Let's build that future together.

name: Lawrence Dawkins
description: Ontario Liberal Party Regional Vice President for Scarborough, North York, and York
excerpt: In the 2025 snap election, held amid a winter snowstorm, Lee surged to victory, helping the Ontario Liberal Party regain official party status.
endorsement:
In her first election as an Ontario Liberal Party candidate, Lee faced a strong Progressive Conservative opponent and came up short. But that defeat did not discourage her, it only strengthened her resolve. In the 2025 snap election, held amid a winter snowstorm, Lee surged to victory, helping the Ontario Liberal Party regain official party status. Her resilience, determination, and unwavering commitment to her community transformed an initial setback into a remarkable success story.

I am supporting Lee because she stood by the Ontario Liberal Party when it wasn't convenient or politically advantageous to do so. She believed in the party, its values, and its future when others doubted it. Her loyalty, commitment, and perseverance helped lay the foundation for the party's resurgence, and those are the qualities I want in a leader.

name: Andrew Delves
description: Finance Chair | University of Toronto Young Liberals
excerpt: Electing Lee as our next leader is an investment in Ontario's future.
endorsement:
Years of mismanagement by the Ford Government have shown Ontario we need a true leader, now; a leader who is empowering, resilient yet adaptable; someone with empathy. I see these attributes in Lee Fairclough.

As President of St Mary's General Hospital, she proved her ability to lead. She brings new perspectives from the healthcare sector into the legislature at a time when it is needed most. She is ready to tackle homelessness across the province and advocate for Ontario's students.

Electing Lee as our next leader is an investment in Ontario's future. We deserve a leader who inspires us to stand up for what is right and work together; someone who will fight for all Ontarians and set the stage for who we are as a province. I believe Lee is the right person to lead the Ontario Liberal Party. I am proud to endorse her.

name: Marc Dupuis
description: Mayor, Mattice-Val Côté
excerpt: Coupled with her experience as a national-level athlete, she reflects resilience, teamwork and determination — qualities that resonate strongly with communities like ours.
endorsement:
As a mayor in northern Ontario, I have come to appreciate leaders who listen with intention, who show up for communities and who carry their values with consistency and humility. In my experience, leadership is not measured only by title, but by character, discipline and a genuine commitment to public service.

I respect the way Lee Fairclough brings these qualities forward. Her extensive background in Ontario’s health sector demonstrates a deep understanding of people, systems and the challenges facing our province. Coupled with her experience as a national-level athlete, she reflects resilience, teamwork and determination — qualities that resonate strongly with communities like ours.

In northern Ontario, we value leaders who work hard, stay grounded and put people first.

From what I have seen, Lee Fairclough embodies these principles with sincerity and strength. I offer this letter as an expression of my respect for her character, her dedication and the thoughtful approach she brings to leadership.

name: Márta Ecsedi, P.Eng., FEC.
description: President, Richmond Hill Provincial Liberal Association
excerpt: Lee has solid credentials as a leader in the health care field.
endorsement:
It is my pleasure to endorse Lee. On every occasion I have met her I have had even more reasons to want her as the next leader of the Ontario Liberal Party. It was because of that and her infectious enthusiasm that I invited her to be the guest speaker at my riding's AGM. Her talk was so motivational.

The new Board came away invigorated and rejuvenated. I know that that is how the Ontario Party will feel with her as our leader. Lee has solid credentials as a leader in the health care field. She has held significant positions and has a proven track record. Also, the makings for a great leader of our party.

name: Lorna Jean Edmonds
description: 2025 Ontario and Federal Liberal Candidate | Leeds–Grenville–Thousand Islands and Rideau Lakes
excerpt: She is smart, steadfast, strong, sincere and strategic.
endorsement:
Lee Fairclough is the leader Ontario voters want for the next Premier. She is smart, steadfast, strong, sincere and strategic. Lee is forward thinking and bold with years of leadership experience.

She grew up in rural Ontario and over the past months has been out-and-about across the province with a particular focus on northern and rural communities. Lee has been listening, hearing what matters most to us on issues like health, affordability, jobs and the environment and can bring about real, progressive change across Ontario – rural and urban.

Along with an outstanding team of MPPs, Lee will start DAY 1 to confront and then beat Doug Ford.

name: Malak Elgendy
description: President, Toronto Centre Ontario Young Liberals
excerpt: MPP Lee Fairclough has proven her dedication to bettering the lives of all Ontarians.
endorsement:
MPP Lee Fairclough has proven her dedication to bettering the lives of all Ontarians. Her commitment to investing in the future of Ontario is clear in her priorities. Education, healthcare, and affordability all affect our quality of life.

I’m choosing to support Lee because I can trust her commitment and promise to address these key issues.

name: Murray Elston
description: Former MPP for Huron–Bruce | Former Ontario Minister of Health
excerpt: Lee knows how to listen when people speak and take action to help.
endorsement: I am endorsing Lee for leader because first she is in politics for the right reason. To make everyone's life better. Secondly Lee's work experience has shown that Lee can bring people together to solve complex problems that threaten an organization. Perhaps it comes from her Huron Bruce roots or her strong sense of family but Lee knows how to listen when people speak and take action to help. Now more than ever we need people who listen first and then take action. We need a person like Lee who will bring us together to make Ontario stronger.

name: Johl Emtage-Cave
description: President, Guelph University Young Liberals
excerpt: Lee is a true team player and a fighter, exactly the kind of leader our party needs at this pivotal moment.
endorsement:
I'm proud to endorse Lee Fairclough for leader of the Ontario Liberal Party. Lee is a true team player and a fighter, exactly the kind of leader our party needs at this pivotal moment.

Every conversation I've had about her plan for Ontario has reinforced that she puts youth success at the centre of her agenda, and as a student leader, that's not something I take for granted. In the time I've known Lee, I've consistently seen her ability to plan, organize, and bring people together; paired with an attention to detail and a genuinely future-focused mindset that this party needs to rebuild and win.

I'm confident Lee has what it takes to lead the Ontario Liberals forward, and I hope you'll join me in supporting her candidacy.

name: Emma Fortunato
description: Vice President of Equity, Ontario Young Liberals
excerpt: Lee believes young people deserve a seat at the table and is ready to do the work to build an Ontario where we can actually see a future for ourselves.
endorsement:
I'm proud to support Lee Fairclough for Leader of the Ontario Liberal Party.

As VP Equity for the Ontario Young Liberals, I spend a lot of time talking to young people across Ontario. We're tired of being told to wait our turn while affordability gets worse, mental health supports fall behind, and too many people are left struggling. Lee believes young people deserve a seat at the table and is ready to do the work to build an Ontario where we can actually see a future for ourselves. That's the kind of leadership I'm proud to get behind.

name: Ashley Fox
description: RPN · OLRNC RVP Southwest | Ontario Liberal Candidate for Perth–Wellington, 2022 & 2025
excerpt: She listens, builds relationships, and focuses on practical solutions that improve people's lives.
endorsement:
I've known Lee Fairclough since the pandemic, when we were both working in healthcare in Kitchener. Lee's willingness to collaborate, mentor, and lead when the path wasn't always clear stood out; she created space for every voice to be heard. Rather than working in silos, she brought people together, welcomed different perspectives, and made it feel like everyone had a meaningful role in shaping better policy. That approach was refreshing and, most important, effective.

When we both ran as Ontario Liberal candidates in 2022 and 2025, I saw the kind of leadership our party needs. I encouraged her to consider a leadership bid. I believe the path to forming government runs through rural and northern Ontario, and I've always respected leaders who are willing to listen, show up, and earn trust in communities too often overlooked. Lee never shied away from those conversations, not then and not now.

Party and governance reform cannot happen without collaboration. Lee understands that firsthand. She listens, builds relationships, and focuses on practical solutions that improve people's lives.

I believe Lee has the experience, and leadership to unite our party, strengthen our policy, and lead the Ontario Liberals forward to governing.

name: Sheila Gervais
description: Former National Director, Liberal Party of Canada
excerpt: She not only listens, but hears - and acts.
endorsement: I'm impressed by Lee's natural leadership qualities. She not only listens, but hears - and acts. Her collaborative, convening approach to political discourse makes her the ideal Leader for OLP and Ontario in these challenging times. She has my full and enthusiastic support.

name: Deborah Gillis
description: Former President & CEO, Centre for Addiction and Mental Health Foundation.
excerpt: Lee is inclusive and decisive; a woman of integrity.
endorsement: During my professional career I have learned kindness, tolerance and humility are synonymous with strength and resilience. They are qualities that reflect a true leader rather than bluster and bravado. Lee Fairclough can be tough when she needs to be but also understands that progress is best made by a team that works together, where other voices are included. Lee is inclusive and decisive; a woman of integrity. I believe she is the leader the Ontario Liberal party needs and I support her without hesitation.

name: Alison Gohel
description: Past Candidate for Oakville, 2022 and 2025
excerpt: Lee Fairclough embodies that same conviction — plus she brings the record, the sharpness, and the energy to turn that belief into government.
endorsement: I ran in Oakville because I believe in what this party stands for. Lee Fairclough embodies that same conviction — plus she brings the record, the sharpness, and the energy to turn that belief into government. She's the leader this moment calls for, and I'm fully behind her.

name: Anne Golden
description: Anne Golden C.M., O.Ont.Former President, United Way of Greater TorontoFormer President and CEO, Conference Board of Canada
excerpt: Lee Fairclough will do the right thing for the right reasons.
endorsement: Lee Fairclough will do the right thing for the right reasons. She has the integrity, the competence and the track record of delivering results that will inspire us, and give us faith that we can solve the many problems that Ontario has today. I fully endorse Lee Fairclough to be the leader of the Ontario Liberal Party and hopefully the next Premier of our province.

name: Mark Gravoso
description: Immediate Past President | Integrated Filipino Canadian Nurses’ Association
excerpt: We need a champion. That’s Lee Fairclough.
endorsement:
It took me four years to get my RN license here from the Philippines. From registering and finding meaningful employment to settling into our communities, I know the struggle firsthand.

Lee took the time to listen and asked what needed to change. She worked on the front lines of healthcare, so she understands where the system fails for many hardworking IENs already here in Ontario.

The Filipino community needs more than a seat at the table.

We need a champion. That’s Lee Fairclough.

name: Andrew Hallikas
description: Mayor of Fort Frances
excerpt: Lee is genuine and truly listens to people from all walks of life.
endorsement: As a Northwestern Ontario Mayor, I am greatly appreciative when politicians from the GTA take the time and make the effort and commitment to visit us, speak with our residents, and learn about our issues. Lee has done this. I am convinced that as Leader of the Ontario Liberal Party, she will effectively represent Northwestern Ontario as she will all of the province. Lee is genuine and truly listens to people from all walks of life. She has a strong understanding of the needs and problems of small rural municipalities as she does larger urban centres. Lee has the strength of character, commitment, and integrity that will serve her well as Leader, making Ontario a better place for all of us.

name: Ava Hatton
description: President, Queen's University Young Liberals | Women's Representative on the YLC exec
excerpt: I'm excited to support Lee in this leadership race because she's the candidate that made me feel hopeful about the Ontario Liberal Party again.
endorsement:
I'm excited to support Lee in this leadership race because she's the candidate that made me feel hopeful about the Ontario Liberal Party again.

Lee is the candidate who believes our generation's success is Ontario's success, and is committed to making Ontario a province where we can feel optimistic about the future.

As Women's Representative of the YLC, and the President of the Queen's Young Liberals, I've seen Lee show herself firsthand to be dedicated to youth issues and youth engagement.

From always taking the time to talk to the youngest person in the room to visiting campuses across Ontario, Lee is the kind of candidate I'm proud to support in this race.

name: Adam Hopkins
description: Past Candidate, Ontario Liberal Party | Peterborough–Kawartha
excerpt: I believe Lee brings the experience, integrity, and collaborative approach needed to unite our party.
endorsement: I’m proud to endorse Lee for Leader of the Ontario Liberal Party. As the most recent Liberal candidate in Peterborough–Kawartha, I understand the importance of rebuilding trust and offering Ontarians a compelling vision for the future. Ontario needs leadership that recognizes the connection between a strong economy, affordable communities, and opportunities for everyone to succeed. Through my work in education and community leadership, I’ve seen how investments in people, skills, and local economies can create lasting prosperity. I believe Lee brings the experience, integrity, and collaborative approach needed to unite our party, strengthen Ontario’s economic future, and ensure that prosperity is broadly shared. I’m excited to support her and encourage fellow Liberals to do the same.

name: Syed Aminul Islam
description: President, Scarborough Southwest Provincial Liberal Association
excerpt: Lee is a dedicated, principled, and community-focused leader with the vision and integrity to strengthen our party and serve the people of Ontario.
endorsement: Proud to endorse Lee Fairclough for Leader of the Ontario Liberal Party. Lee is a dedicated, principled, and community-focused leader with the vision and integrity to strengthen our party and serve the people of Ontario. I am proud to support her leadership campaign and encourage Ontario Liberals to join me in supporting Lee.

name: Elizabeth (Liz) Jaku
description: Diversity and Equity Co-Chair | University of Toronto Young Liberals
excerpt: I recognize her commitment to improving healthcare and strengthening the overall well-being of Ontarians.
endorsement: I am pleased to endorse Lee Fairclough for the next Leader of the Ontario Liberal Party. Through my understanding of her dedication and experience in building a healthier Ontario, I recognize her commitment to improving healthcare and strengthening the overall well-being of Ontarians. Her experience and dedication have showcased the importance of knowledgeable leadership and a consistent focus on the needs of Ontarians.

name: Linda Jeffrey
description: Former MPP for Brampton Centre / Brampton-Springdale | Former Minister of Natural Resources, Minister of Labour, Minister Responsible for Seniors, and Minister of Municipal Affairs and Housing
excerpt: What I appreciate most is her steady, thoughtful approach—she listens, she learns, and she leads with purpose.
endorsement:
Many of us who’ve lived in Ontario a long time have seen the province change in ways that don’t always feel reassuring. Lately, I’ve been concerned about decisions from the Conservative Government that weaken the services people depend on, along with behaviour from some MPPs that doesn’t reflect the integrity Ontarians expect.

This fall, Ontario Liberals will choose a new leader, and I’ve been thinking about what kind of leadership our province truly needs.

For me, Lee Fairclough stands out.

Lee is a sitting MPP with more than 25 years of experience improving healthcare across Ontario. She’s a former national rugby player, a healthcare executive, and now the Liberal critic for hospitals, mental health, addictions, and homelessness. What I appreciate most is her steady, thoughtful approach—she listens, she learns, and she leads with purpose.

For those of us who have been here through decades of change, choosing a leader is about protecting the Ontario we care about and strengthening it for the next generation. I encourage you to take a moment to learn more about Lee and consider the kind of leadership you want guiding our province forward.

I hope you’ll join me in supporting Lee Fairclough.

name: Arthur Khassanov
description: President, University of Toronto Young Liberals
excerpt: Lee is progressive, caring, and willing to sit down and have a discussion with you on the issues that matter most.
endorsement:
It is my absolute honour and pleasure to support Lee Fairclough to be the next leader of the Ontario Liberal Party.

Lee is progressive, caring, and willing to sit down and have a discussion with you on the issues that matter most, an approach that is hard to find elsewhere. I have seen Lee and how she interacts with young people and students from across the province. I have seen how deeply she cares about the issues plaguing young people in Ontario, from cuts to OSAP, to our packed classrooms, to the defunding seen in the social and medical services Ontarians rely on most, particularly those of my generation. Lee demonstrates a commitment not just to tackle the many crises from eight years of Conservative Government but also a commitment to building a stronger Ontario for all, no matter creed, gender or age.

name: Heather Kirkconnell
description: President | Mississauga-Lakeshore Provincial Liberal Association
excerpt: She is a leader capable of confronting opposition with grace and grit.
endorsement:
I am proud to endorse MPP Lee Fairclough for Leader of the Ontario Liberal Party. Building riding associations is in her blood. She is passionate about developing the party from the grassroots up and has assisted others outside her own riding learn how to do this well before running for Leader.

Lee's relationship-building skills are fundamental to why she has been able to forge teams throughout her life, in the world of health care and as an athlete. Lee embodies integrity and determination. She is a leader capable of confronting opposition with grace and grit.

name: Zayaan Ladhani
description: President, Brock University Young Liberals
excerpt: She continues to dedicate her time helping to make Ontario a better place.
endorsement: Lee Fairclough has worn many public service hats from public health, to President of St. Mary's Hospital, in my home town of Kitchener, during the pandemic to being elected MPP of Etobicoke-Lakeshore. She continues to dedicate her time helping to make Ontario a better place. Her dedication is why I'm endorsing Lee to be Leader of the Ontario Liberal Party for a better Ontario.

name: Réal Lavergne
description: Co-chair of Revitalizing Our Democracy
excerpt: She has the skills and experience; she shares my priorities; she has the right attitude.
endorsement:
I am endorsing Lee Fairclough for leader because of the way she combines what I am looking for. She has the skills and experience; she shares my priorities; she has the right attitude, seeing herself as part of a team with different contributions to make.

I am especially concerned about the state of our democracy. Lee recognizes that our electoral system and political financing regime require serious examination and reform. She has promised to name an Advocate for Democratic Reforms to work with other parties and prepare the ground for change. That’s the kind of systematic and meaningful approach we need.

name: Dr. Elisa Levi
description: Anishinaabe family physician from the Chippewas of Nawash Unceded First Nation
excerpt: She builds trust, brings people together, and works alongside communities to create meaningful change.
endorsement: I am proud to endorse Lee Fairclough for Leader of the Ontario Liberal Party. I had the privilege of working with Lee at the Canadian Partnership Against Cancer, where I witnessed her genuine commitment to people, communities, and the teams she led. Through my work in Indigenous health and as a family physician, I know how important it is to have leaders who listen and ensure those most affected have a voice in decisions that shape their lives. I saw this firsthand in Lee. She builds trust, brings people together, and works alongside communities to create meaningful change. Lee brings experience, compassion, and integrity, along with the humility to listen and the courage to make difficult decisions. This is the leadership we need for a better future.

name: Lorraine Liu
description: Events Chair | University of Toronto Young Liberals
excerpt: Lee has shown that she cares about young people, and her seat in the Legislature proves that she can fight on behalf of young Ontarians.
endorsement: I am proud to endorse Lee Fairclough to be the next leader of the Ontario Liberal Party. Lee has shown that she cares about young people, and her seat in the Legislature proves that she can fight on behalf of young Ontarians. She has the experience, knowledge and passion to do what is best for our party, and she has demonstrated that time and time again. Young people are facing unprecedented times right now, and Lee is just what the province’s youth needs at this pivotal and important time.

name: Eric Lombardi
description: Former OLP Leadership Candidate | Finance and Technology Entrepreneur
excerpt: I have watched her grow as a candidate, take nothing for granted, and approach this race with grit and openness.
endorsement:
I endorse Lee Fairclough to be the next Ontario Liberal Leader & Premier of Ontario

Over the many months of this campaign, I have had the privilege to get to know Lee Fairclough well. I have watched her grow as a candidate, take nothing for granted, and approach this race with grit and openness.

Lee and I do not agree on everything. What I have come to appreciate is that she is comfortable with disagreement. She listens, pushes back, asks good questions, and is willing to reconsider when presented with new information. She is substantive, pragmatic and genuinely interested in getting things right for Ontarians. I've thoroughly enjoyed our conversations.

Her attitude, grit, and potential have made me confident in her leadership. As Ontarians get to know Lee, I know they will too.

I've offered to serve as a formal adviser to Lee on economic, housing and infrastructure issues, among others. We have agreed to work together on making productivity growth a priority, on reforming municipal finance so infrastructure growth does not come at the expense of new housing, on directly addressing the milestone recession facing young Ontarians, and on fundamentally changing an infrastructure system that spends far too much and builds far too little.

Lee understands that stronger growth is necessary if we want to sustainably invest in healthcare, education, and the public services people depend on. It's that balance that Ontarians seek from our party, and I have no doubt she can deliver it.

name: Lori Lopes RN
description: RN | Vice President | Whitby Provincial Liberal Association | Vice President Membership | Ontario Women’s Liberal Commission
excerpt: Hers is leadership I can trust.
endorsement:
There are many reasons I support Lee, but ultimately it comes down to one guiding principle: trust.

Lee has a natural ability to connect with people. It isn’t political polish, it’s genuine humanity, authenticity, compassion, empathy and integrity. She listens, understands and makes people feel heard.

Her leadership experience is equally impressive. As a hospital executive and sports team leader, Lee knows how to build strong teams, bring people together and lead through challenges. She is a solutions-focused expert who understands complex systems and how to make them work better.

As a radiation therapist, Lee’s career has been grounded in protecting the public interest and maintaining high standards of practice. As someone who holds a similar professional licence, that matters deeply to me.

So I ask myself:

If I had cancer, would I trust Lee with my life? Yes.

If I worked under her leadership, would I trust her to protect professional standards? Yes.

Is Lee running for Leader for the right reasons? Yes.

Lee brings something uniquely valuable to leadership: expertise, humanity and a systems-level understanding of how Ontario works.

Hers is leadership I can trust.

name: Mathew Lund
description: Former President | Simcoe North Provincial Liberal Association
excerpt: Her strategy is not simply about winning the Liberal Party; it is about rebuilding a Liberal Party capable of winning Ontario.
endorsement:
This race is about who can rebuild a party capable of winning a provincial election.

We must speak to the nurse in Toronto, the small-business owner in Orillia, the farmer in Southwestern Ontario, the tradesperson in the north, the young suburban family and the senior in a small town and convince them they belong in the Liberal Party.

Lee will build trust in rural, northern, and remote communities, rather than treat them as afterthoughts. Her proposal to develop regional policy is notable. So is her commitment to strengthen local riding associations, develop candidates earlier and maintain a physical presence across Ontario. Her proposals include rural healthcare investment, agricultural supports, regional transportation infrastructure, and rural and northern economic development.

Lee offers the strongest and best path to rebuilding the Ontario Liberal Party. Her strategy is not simply about winning the Liberal Party; it is about rebuilding a Liberal Party capable of winning Ontario.

name: Rod MacDonald
excerpt: Coming from a small community in Bruce County, Lee is knowledgeable on rural issues.
endorsement: The next leader of the Ontario Liberal Party needs to be strong, confident and not afraid of hard work. That leader will represent the entire province and not just one region. Lee Fairclough is all of these and more. She understands the province. She's not from downtown. Lee understands the challenges we face and wants to reach out to people for their ideas on solutions. She's inclusive and genuinely interested in helping make life better for all Ontarians. Coming from a small community in Bruce County, Lee is knowledgeable on rural issues, and her experience with Team Canada Rugby taught her that you can win when you play as a team. Lee will bring positive change to Ontario. She's the right Leader for the Ontario Liberal Party.

name: Akaash Maharaj
description: Former National Policy Chair of the Liberal Party of Canada | Former Canadian Representative to the Liberal International
excerpt: Lee’s priorities are the priorities that we could once take for granted, but which have now become painfully rare: competence, democracy, and integrity in government.
endorsement:
I am impressed by Lee’s vision for a Party and a government that would be worthy of the people of Ontario.

She has faced up to the hard reality that to make a compelling case to Ontarians, the Ontario Liberal Party needs to begin by reforming and reenergising itself. The Party must be willing and able to draw on the talents of members across the province — and to stand accountable to them — to demonstrate that it would form a government of all Ontarians, for all Ontarians.

Lee’s priorities are the priorities that we could once take for granted, but which have now become painfully rare: competence, democracy, and integrity in government.

Most of all, I feel Lee would appeal to the better natures of Ontarians. Too many political actors try to climb to power by setting us against one another; I believe she would instead try to lift our province up, by drawing us all together.

I am pleased to endorse Lee Fairclough for Leader of the Ontario Liberal Party.

name: Nate Manis
description: National Policy Chair, Young Liberals of Canada
excerpt: Lee represents a change in approach - she truly understands the issues, she’s an effective communicator, and she has the drive and the know-how to grow our party in every region across Ontario.
endorsement:
I am a Liberal because I believe in building more affordable, safe, and sustainable communities. Having the privilege to work with Young Liberals from all across Canada, and from my own friends and peers, I see firsthand how eager young people are for bold, pragmatic leadership.

Ontario Liberals are making a crucially important choice in November. Our next leader needs to truly understand the challenges facing my generation, with a concrete set of ideas to tackle them. Throughout this race, Lee has consistently shown leadership and boldness in so many key areas - on affordability, housing, education including post-secondary, rural and northern communities, and so much more.

Young Ontarians deserve an Ontario Liberal Party that stays focused on building a better future for them. Lee represents a change in approach - she truly understands the issues, she’s an effective communicator, and she has the drive and the know-how to grow our party in every region across Ontario. I’m proud to support Lee!

name: John Manley
description: Former Deputy Minister, Former Minister of Industry, Foreign Affairs and Finance
excerpt: Most importantly, Lee has a willingness to listen and to learn.
endorsement: "I am delighted to be putting my support behind Lee as Leader of the Ontario Liberal Party. Lee brings a fresh perspective and an ability to build teams, and support across various groups in Ontario. She has experience in one of our most important issues, health care. Most importantly, Lee has a willingness to listen and to learn. She can build an Ontario that’s stronger and better for all of us."

name: Josh Matlow
description: Toronto City CouncillorToronto-St. Paul's, Ward 12
excerpt: I’m convinced Lee has the experience, skills and character to put people and communities first—and get us back on the right track.
endorsement:
Doug Ford is failing to deliver for Ontarians. Our province needs a leader who is honest, competent and focused on priorities including healthcare, education, stable jobs, affordability, and reliable transportation infrastructure—not jets, vanity projects or making their friends rich while the average person is struggling to pay for housing, gas and groceries.

Queen’s Park should also be working with municipalities, not against them, to deliver the critical services and infrastructure our communities need most.

That’s why I’m very proud to support Lee Fairclough for Ontario Liberal Party leader and next Premier of Ontario. I’m convinced Lee has the experience, skills and character to put people and communities first—and get us back on the right track.

name: Deb Matthews
description: Former Deputy Premier and Former Minister of Health and Long-Term Care
excerpt: Lee is a strong, inclusive, and relentless leader.
endorsement: Lee is a strong, inclusive, and relentless leader. She is brilliant, hardworking and represents Liberal values in her daily work. Lee is a refreshing change in today's polarized world and I would be proud to call her my leader.

name: Judy McKay
excerpt: Lee Fairclough is the one candidate with the background and qualifications to stand up for public health care.
endorsement:
Lee Fairclough is the one candidate with the background and qualifications to stand up for public health care. She knows from personal experience the challenges of managing a public hospital with diminishing resources, how the current government is putting profits above public access. She's seen first hand the damage a Govenment can do when profits take precedence over investing in care.

To me, Lee Fairclough represents hope for continuing investment in a provincial health care system that will still be there when we need it. There can be no better advocate and I am pleased to support her for Leader of the Liberal Party.

name: Lyn McLeod
description: Former Leader | Ontario Liberal Party
excerpt: I was impressed with Lee’s commitment to the re-building of our Party.
endorsement: From the first time I met her, I was impressed with Lee’s commitment to the re-building of our Party. As a former leader of the Ontario Liberal Party, I firmly believe that if we are to win elections, it has to be done riding by riding. Lee understands this and she will do the work on the ground needed to make that happen.

name: Hon. Ted McMeekin
description: Former MPP for Ancaster—Dundas—Flamborough—Aldershot and Ancaster—Dundas—Flamborough—Westdale | Former Ontario Minister of Municipal Affairs and Housing
excerpt: Lee Fairclough, MPP for Etobicoke—Lakeshore has the vision, discipline, integrity and strong work ethic needed to restore greatness to Ontario.
endorsement:
Lee Fairclough, MPP for Etobicoke—Lakeshore has the vision, discipline, integrity and strong work ethic needed to restore greatness to Ontario. Hamilton Liberals who have met Lee quickly recognise her incredible health care background and passion for the possible.

As a former Ontario Minister of Housing, I was deeply impressed with her knowledge of the challenges related to housing and practical steps that can be taken to respond to our housing crisis.

Lee has a long and distinguished record of building effective teams that have delivered important healthcare initiatives. Her years of competitive swimming at McMaster and experience playing on Canada’s National Rugby Team add an exciting dimension to her solid leadership resume.

Lee Fairclough is the leader Ontario needs to fix what’s broken and restore the Ontario we all deserve.

name: Hon. Maria Minna
description: Former Minister of International Cooperation and Member of Parliament for Beaches-East York
excerpt: Lee is exactly the leader we need at this critical time in our province's history.
endorsement:
Lee Fairclough's executive-level experience in health care is exactly what we need in this time of privatization, emergency department closures, long waiting lists, doctor shortages and the other negative effects of Doug Ford's dismal record on health care.

She knows what needs to be done on health care and all of the other key issues facing our province today and will be sure that it is done – and done well.

I admire her commitment to public service and track record of accomplishments.

Lee is exactly the leader we need at this critical time in our province's history.

She has my full support.

name: Carol Mitchell
description: Former MPP, Huron-Bruce | Former Ontario Minister of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs
excerpt: Lee has the wisdom, integrity, and humility needed to grow the Ontario Liberal Party in every riding across the province.
endorsement:
Lee has the wisdom, integrity, and humility needed to grow the Ontario Liberal Party in every riding across the province.

We share strong roots in Huron and Bruce Counties, and Lee's rural upbringing shapes the practical approach, which is evident in her leadership.

Lee understands how agriculture sustains rural communities and underpins Ontario's economy, food security, and quality of life.

She is attuned to the challenges facing farmers and is a strong advocate for rural Ontario at Queen's Park.

name: Devon Monkhouse
description: CFO, Eric Lombardi Leadership Campaign | Past Candidate, Stormont–Dundas–South Glengarry | Secretary-Treasurer, Ontario Liberal Rural and Northern Commission
excerpt: Lee knows how to win.
endorsement:
For the past several months I served as CFO for Eric Lombardi’s leadership campaign. When Eric stepped back and endorsed Lee Fairclough, I took a hard look at where I could do the most good moving forward for the Ontario Liberal Party. I’m proud to say I’m now backing Lee.

Lee knows how to win. She cares about getting the work done, and done right. After our disappointing results in 2022 she never stopped knocking doors and building our Liberal community in her home riding. In 2025 Lee took back Etobicoke—Lakeshore from the PCs by eight points. She is the kind of Leader we need. Lee knows how to grow this party and give Ontarians a real alternative to Doug Ford, and has done so on his own home turf.

I believe that Lee brings to the OLP a Leader you can vote for, instead of relying on an electorate to vote against a government they don’t like.

name: Ehsan Mosaheb
description: President, York University Young Liberals
excerpt: She's the leader we need to hold this government accountable and get young Liberals a seat at the table.
endorsement:
I'm proud to support Lee Fairclough for Leader of the Ontario Liberal Party.

As President of the York University Young Liberals, I talk to students who are doing everything right and still can't see a future for themselves here — rent they can't afford, a job market where young people now wait the longest they have in decades, and a healthcare system where you can wait hours in an ER or months for care, and a government blaming young students for its own incompetence.

Lee gets it. She's spent her career inside our healthcare system and knows how to fix what's hurting families across Ontario. She's the leader we need to hold this government accountable and get young Liberals a seat at the table. Unlike the people running this province right now, she doesn't see young people as a problem to manage. She listens, she takes us seriously, and she's ready to build an Ontario we can actually afford to live in. That's who I want leading the Ontario Liberal Party — and this province.

That's the kind of leader our generation has been waiting for, and it's why I'm proud to get behind her.

name: Aryana Nafaji
description: Vice President York University Young Liberals | Nursing Student
excerpt: Lee has the vision, integrity and determination to bring people together, tackle the challenges Ontario is facing and build a stronger future for every Ontarian.
endorsement: I'm proud to endorse MPP Lee Fairclough for Leader of the Ontario Liberal Party. As a nursing student, I've learned the best leaders are the ones who listen early, earn peoples' trust and never lose sight of why they serve. That's exactly what I see in Lee. She understands that improving healthcare, strengthening our economy, and supporting our communities all go hand-in-hand. Lee has the vision, integrity and determination to bring people together, tackle the challenges Ontario is facing and build a stronger future for every Ontarian.

name: Hrishieka Nigam
description: President, UofT Scarborough Young Liberals
excerpt: She has not only been vocal about the dishevelment caused by the Ford government, but she actually has a plan.
endorsement: Lee has inspired me since the time I lived in her riding and continues to do that as I involve myself more in politics. She has not only been vocal about the dishevelment caused by the Ford government, but she actually has a plan. I have full faith in Lee's leadership because she has firsthand experience within the system that she aims to make a change in. Lee is incredibly driven, proactive, and humble; and so is her team. She has left a mark on me because I found her honesty and meticulousness very reassuring. As someone who is disgruntled by the current provincial government, I believe that we need someone who is a true team player, which is why I am proud to endorse Lee Fairclough for Leader of the Ontario Liberal Party.

name: Reg Niganobe
description: Former Chief, Mississauga First Nation | Former Grand Council Chief, Anishinabek Nation | Former Ontario Liberal Candidate, Algoma—Manitoulin
excerpt: Lee has made the North a priority — not just in words, but in action.
endorsement:
As the past Ontario Liberal candidate for Algoma—Manitoulin, I know firsthand what it means to step up and fight for a community that too often gets left behind.

For years, northern and rural Ontario has been treated as an afterthought by Doug Ford's government. Emergency rooms have closed. Essential health services have disappeared. While Queen's Park focuses on the greater metropolitan area, communities like ours are left to manage on their own. That's not good enough. And it has to change.

That's why I'm supporting Lee Fairclough to become the next Leader of the Ontario Liberal Party — and why I'm asking you to join me.

I've spent my career advocating for First Nations and northern communities — as Chief of Mississauga First Nation, as Grand Council Chief of the Anishinabek Nation, and as Chairman of the North Shore Tribal Council. I've fought for change at every level of government. I know what real leadership looks like, and I know what it takes to earn the trust of communities that have been overlooked for too long.

When I look at Lee Fairclough, I see that kind of leadership.

Lee has made the North a priority — not just in words, but in action. She understands that health care, economic prosperity, and genuine party renewal aren't just policy planks. They're what people in communities like ours need to thrive. She has shown a real commitment to northern Ontario, and she has earned my trust and my support.

Our party needs a leader who can rebuild from the ground up, energize Liberals in every corner of this province, and make the case to Ontarians that there is a better way forward. Lee is that leader.

Miigwech. Thank you.

name: Dorothy Noronha
description: President, Northumberland–Peterborough South PLA | Engagement Coordinator, Ontario Liberal Rural and Northern Commission | Past Candidate, Northumberland–Peterborough South
excerpt: Her depth of experience in healthcare and leadership was unmatched.
endorsement:
As a new campaign manager in the 2022 provincial election, I was struck by the quality and depth of our candidates. Lee Fairclough was no exception. Her depth of experience in healthcare and leadership was unmatched. Even before being elected, Lee joined MPP Adil Shamji for a town hall on rural healthcare in our riding. Lee showed up ready to work, knocking on doors before the event.

After years of careers in business, WSIB and insurance partnerships in hospitals, and as a former teacher, the destruction of our public institutions by the Ford Government drew me to the Ontario Liberal Party as it did Lee. We need to earn the trust of Ontarians one riding at a time. With Lee Fairclough as our leader and with our caucus at Queen's Park, I know we can get back on the field in Rural and Northern Ontario!

name: Damien O'Brien
description: Former Ontario Liberal Candidate for Niagara Centre 2025 | Former OLP Executive Vice-President
excerpt: Lee perseveres, she never gives up, and is the best candidate to deliver the change our party and our province desperately needs.
endorsement: As an active Ontario Liberal for over 20 years in countless roles, I know what you know: we need to change if we ever hope to earn the privilege of governing again. Lee Fairclough is an experienced, inclusive leader who understands the problems that people are facing. She also knows that success in politics is grounded both in hard work & working together. Lee perseveres, she never gives up, and is the best candidate to deliver the change our party and our province desperately needs.

name: Bhavik Parikh
description: Former Ontario Liberal Candidate for Brampton South 2025
excerpt: Lee brings valuable healthcare experience, a genuine connection with communities, and a clear vision for the future of Ontario.
endorsement:
I am proud to endorse Lee Fairclough for her leadership, experience, and commitment to public service.

As a past candidate in Brampton South, I understand the importance of strong, compassionate, and community-focused leadership. Lee brings valuable healthcare experience, a genuine connection with communities, and a clear vision for the future of Ontario.

I am pleased to support Lee and wish her every success in her leadership.

name: Gordon Phaneuf
description: Former President | Ontario Liberal Party
excerpt: She has promised that every region from the biggest cities to rural, northern and remote communities will have a seat at the table.
endorsement:
The Ontario Liberal Party is more than a Leader and a Campaign Team. OLP includes candidates, local PLAs, Commissions and volunteers. We help lead the Party to victory.

Lee recognizes that everyone has a role to play and needs to be part of the plan. As Leader she has committed to visiting every riding of the province regardless how far from Queen’s Park, to meet with the membership and work alongside local teams to build a winning strategy in every riding, every election. She has promised that every region from the biggest cities to rural, northern and remote communities will have a seat at the table. With visits to over half or all ridings already, this is our chance to influence change.

As a former Party President, I am pleased to join other current and former members of Executive Council in supporting Lee Fairclough for Leader of the Ontario Liberal Party.

name: James Rice
description: Chair, Huron-Bruce Federal Liberal AssociationFormer Candidate, Liberal Party of Canada for Huron-Bruce (2025)
excerpt: She will be a leader for all Ontarians, no matter their postal code.

As Chair of the Huron–Bruce Federal Liberal Association and a federal Liberal candidate, I hear regularly from people across rural Ontario who feel forgotten by those in power—Progressive Conservative and Liberal alike. Ontario’s borders don’t end at the GTA, and our province needs a leader who understands that.

That’s why I’m proud to endorse Lee Fairclough for Leader of the Ontario Liberal Party.

Raised in rural Ontario and now living in and representing an urban community, Lee understands that our province’s strength comes from all of its communities—rural, urban, northern and everything in between. She will be a leader for all Ontarians, no matter their postal code.

Lee brings the experience, vision and determination Ontario needs to get our beautiful province back on track and restore its place as a leader in our federation.

I’m proud to support Lee Fairclough for Ontario Liberal Leader.

name: Tony Ruprecht
description: Former Ontario Minister of Citizenship-MulticulturalismFormer MPP for Davenport

I am pleased to give Lee Fairclough my endorsement.

Lee is a strong supporter of our multiculturalism in Ontario and sees our diversity in Ontario and Canada as one of our greatest strengths.

During her years working in health care, she was aware of how culture and language factored into people's care and outcomes. She also championed diversity in the teams working in health care, and enjoyed sharing in the cultural traditions of team members.

As a leader in the multicultural community, I am confident that Lee is the right person to lead the Liberal Party and represent all Ontarians.

name: Liz Sandals
description: Former MPP, Guelph Former Minister of Education and Former President of Treasury Board
excerpt: She beat an incumbent Tory to win her seat in Doug Ford's Etobicoke stronghold.
endorsement:
I am supporting Lee Fairclough for Leader of the Ontario Liberal Party. I first met Lee when she was the President and CEO of St Mary's Hospital in Kitchener. Lee demonstrated her leadership skills as she navigated her hospital through COVID. She was selected to speak to the media on behalf of all the Waterloo-Wellington hospital CEOs and proved her ability to remain calm and articulate when faced with media pressure.

Lee is a team player, a skill she learned as a member of the Canadian Women's Rugby Team. And growing up in southwestern Ontario and working and travelling throughout Ontario she understands the need to build a Liberal Team that represents all of Ontario.

name: Pankaj Sandhu
description: Secretary | Ontario Liberal Party
excerpt: Lee leads with integrity, compassion, and purpose.
endorsement:
I am proud to endorse MPP Lee Fairclough for Leader of the Ontario Liberal Party.

Ontario needs someone who can bring people together and build a winning coalition to form the next government. Lee has the leadership, experience, and vision to do exactly that.

Lee leads with integrity, compassion, and purpose. She listens, respects different perspectives, and understands that strong leadership means bringing people together.

Her experience as a hospital president illustrates her ability to lead through complex challenges. She entered politics because she wanted to make a difference by improving services for families across our province.

Our Party needs a leader who connects with Ontarians in every community; from rural villages to our largest cities. Lee understands the diversity of our province and has the experience, determination, and ability to build a united movement.

I wholeheartedly support Lee and encourage Liberals across Ontario to join me. Together, we can renew our party, rebuild trust, and build the next Ontario Liberal government.

name: Ramesh Sangha

Lee is committed to working with all communities to address the needs of all Ontarians and to rebuild the party to defeat Doug Ford.

name: Monique Smith
description: Former Nipissing MPP Former Minister and Government House Leader Ontario's former Representative in Washington
