endorsement: Lee is exactly the person we need to lead Ontario now. She understands the challenges Ontarians face. She is willing to do the work and provide Ontarians the principled leadership we deserve.

name: George Smitherman
description: MPP Toronto Centre–Rosedale - 1999–2010 | Former Deputy Premier, Minister of Health and Long-Term Care and Minister of Energy and Infrastructure
excerpt: Why take that risk when we have a proven competitor who is already in the arena, not in the stands?
endorsement:
Why We Can't Choose a Leader Without a Seat – Again

The old line is that insanity is doing the same thing over and over again and expecting a different result. What do you call electing a leader for the third time in a row who has no seat, no vote and no voice on the floor, after the last two left us voiceless in the chamber where it matters?

I was a powerhouse in Toronto Centre, right up until I wasn't. As Steven Del Duca and Bonnie Crombie have proved, getting back in the mix can prove a lot harder than you might think. So, if you are going down that path one more time you need to recognize you may be part of the problem.

Nav may be a fine fellow, but the fact of the matter is his lack of a seat in Ontario may make him just as unelectable, regardless of his political successes running with Justin Trudeau back in the day.

By contrast, Lee Fairclough got herself elected on Doug Ford's presumed Etobicoke turf, during an election when his party was ascending. There is no greater consideration in this election for the OLP Leader.

Better still, Lee brings the experience, credibility, and character needed to take on Ford–not only on the campaign trail, but every day in the Legislature.

What do rugby and the Ontario Legislature have in common? Scrums. As a former member of Canada's Women's Rugby Team, Lee knows a thing or two about scrums. And one thing is certain: scrums at Queen's Park are best reserved for players, not public gallery spectators, because the best ones rely on energy carried over from the chamber.

Experience-wise, Lee Fairclough is a healthcare system expert and former hospital president with granular knowledge of how health care works, and an excellent track record of results, burnished during the COVID-19 pandemic.

Fool me once, shame on you. Fool me twice, shame on me. Fool me a third time? No way. Why take that risk when we have a proven competitor who is already in the arena, not in the stands?

name: Greg Sorbara
description: Chancellor Emeritus York University
excerpt: She listens and she inspires.
endorsement:
I had the honour of spending more than 25 years in the Ontario Legislature, as an MPP, a Minister and as President of the Ontario Liberal Party, Through it all I gained some real insight into what makes a successful leader. Someone who can chart a course for our province to thrive, someone who can inspire others to perform at their highest and best and someone who, through discussion and debate, draws inspiration from others.

Lee Fairclough is all that and more. She listens and she inspires. She knows politics is a team sport and that a great team needs effective leadership. She is among a new breed of political leaders who understand the real challenges that Ontarians face - in their homes, their workplaces and their communities. Her strong experience in health care has helped prepare her to take on the myriad challenges she will face as premier.

I see this leadership election as the essential first step in Lee Fairclough becoming the next Liberal premier of our great province. She has my support and I hope she will have yours.

name: Charles Sousa
description: Member of Parliament for Mississauga—Lakeshore | Former Ontario Minister of Finance
excerpt: Her proven experience in winning a Conservative-held seat is exactly what we need as we rebuild the party.
endorsement:
As Ontario’s Finance Minister, I was proud to table numerous budgets and balance the books while investing more in education, healthcare, and infrastructure. But under the Conservatives we’ve seen 8 years of record-breaking debt, while Ontarians get less and less.

Lee knows firsthand how government budgets impact families and communities. She’s run a complex, multi-million dollar hospital and understands how to achieve positive results. Lee shares my vision that a prosperous Ontario includes a strong and vibrant economy that sustains and secures social programs.

She’s a principled and determined leader who has already earned her place in the legislature where she’s been holding the government to account since day one. Her proven experience in winning a Conservative-held seat is exactly what we need as we rebuild the party.

Lee Fairclough is the leader Ontario needs and I hope you’ll join me in supporting her.

She’s got the compassion, the smarts and the grit to beat Ford and get this province working for working people. I’m proud to be supporting her in this leadership race.

name: Bryan Stortz

name: Asif Syed

Her background as a professional female athlete shows a dedication, determination, and drive that will lead to a better Ontario for everyone. Lee is a committed, passionate leader who can make our Party stronger and I believe she's the one who can also make our province stronger.

Let’s get to work!

name: Joyce Timpson

name: Teresa Toralba

name: Tanya Vrebosch
description: Former Ontario Liberal Candidate for Nipissing
excerpt: It’s refreshing to sit down with someone who actually listens, takes northern perspectives seriously, and brings real-world healthcare experience to the table.
endorsement:

She has spent time touring Northeastern and Northwestern Ontario getting to know who we are and how we differ from other parts of the province; our priorities require sustained attention and presence, not just a quick stop or a “one size fits all” approach. For instance, mental health and addictions place a heavier strain on northern communities; distance makes it harder to access the services we need. With her healthcare background, Lee understands better than most how deeply these issues impact municipalities in the north. She recognizes that we need immediate legislative action, including long-overdue updates to the Mental Health Act, to better support families and frontline workers.

It’s refreshing to sit down with someone who actually listens, takes northern perspectives seriously, and brings real-world healthcare experience to the table. Following our conversation, I am convinced: Lee is my choice for Leader of the Ontario Liberal Party.

name: Eileen Walker

excerpt: She is prepared, knowledgeable, and able to stand up strongly for our values and make the case for a better direction for Ontario.

She will lead from inside the Legislature. We need a leader to hold the government accountable where the decision-making takes place.

But most of all, she knows how to change the trajectory of Ontario’s number one issue: our crumbling public health care system. Lee has the background and vision to reverse a decade of decay. That’s why she has my vote.
